documentation.note: Architecture Scorecard is the high-level architectural maturity dashboard (capability-by-category status + Overall Architecture Health ratings). Keep it current alongside this file and docs/ProjectStatus.md whenever a capability's status changes. docs/releases/ holds one comprehensive, frozen-in-time document per released version (docs/releases/README.md explains the system) -- create a new docs/releases/vX.Y.Z.md every time currentVersion below is bumped. docs/templates/ holds reusable document skeletons (docs/templates/README.md explains the system) -- docs/templates/PreStageChecklist.md must be copied, filled in, and signed off (see docs/reviews/ for completed copies) before starting any new stage or standalone framework addition. docs/ImplementationLog/ (docs/ImplementationLog/README.md explains the system) holds one file per implementation phase (docs/ImplementationLog/Stage<N>/Phase<M>.md), created only when that phase's implementation actually starts -- convention established 2026-08-06 with nothing backfilled; the first real entry, docs/ImplementationLog/Stage3/Phase0.md (T41-T45, across three batches, batch 3 QA Decision: Approved), was created 2026-08-06 and is still In Progress (the original T44/T45 content -- the PreStageChecklist sign-off -- remains open, see openQuestions; ADR-0018, the other half, was subsequently written 2026-08-07; Phase 0's own acceptance criteria require the checklist sign-off before it can be marked Done). Standard matured 2026-08-06 (documentation-process-only change, no implementation work): the Reviewer Checklist grew from 8 to 11 items (added 'Existing design patterns followed', 'AI_BOOTSTRAP updated (if required)', 'PROJECT_STATE updated (if required)'); phase logs now require a 11th section, a formal QA Decision (Approved / Approved with comments / Rework required) gating documentation sync and merge; and docs/ImplementationLog/README.md now defines Canonical Document Roles (no-duplication rules across ImplementationLog/SessionReport/CHANGELOG/ADR/IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE) and Documentation Ownership (primary-editor assignment by role: Project Manager, Software Architect, Developer, QA Reviewer, Documentation Manager -- primary, not exclusive). See docs/ImplementationLog/README.md and AI_BOOTSTRAP.md for the full standard.

backendSubsystems.name: Stage 3 Phase 1 -- AuthService + tests (T50/T51)
backendSubsystems.note: application/auth_service.py: authenticate(email, password) -> Result[User, AppError] (verifies via T46's verify_password(), checks is_active, records last_login_at), issue_tokens(user) -> tuple[str, str] (T47's create_access_token/create_refresh_token, persists a hashed RefreshToken row), refresh(refresh_token) -> Result[tuple[str, str], AppError] (JWT + DB validation, rotates: revokes old, issues new pair), revoke(refresh_token) -> None (idempotent). Two new narrow ports (application/interfaces/user_repository.py, refresh_token_repository.py), each AbstractRepository + one lookup method, implemented by SqlAlchemyUserRepository/SqlAlchemyRefreshTokenRepository -- the first real reader/writer of T49's refresh_tokens table. infrastructure/security/token_hasher.py: SHA-256 (not Argon2 -- deterministic hashing needed for exact-match lookup). 28 tests (24 in tests/unit/test_auth_service.py, 4 in tests/unit/test_token_hasher.py), first run 28/28 passing. Not yet wired into configure_container() or any route -- needs a per-request AsyncSession, same reason DBSessionDep stays outside the container -- that's T52+. QA Decision: Approved with comments (no rework required; comment on an IMPLEMENTATION_QUEUE.md ownership deviation, not the implementation). See docs/ImplementationLog/Stage3/Phase1.md.

backendSubsystems.name: Stage 3 Phase 2 -- JwtAuthenticationProvider (T52)
backendSubsystems.note: infrastructure/auth/jwt_authentication_provider.py: real AuthenticationProvider (D7/ADR-0019) -- decodes the bearer token via T47's decode_token(), then re-derives identity/roles live from the database via T50's UserRepository, never trusting the token's own roles claim (same defense-in-depth pattern as AuthService.refresh()). token=None, any decode failure, malformed sub, unknown user, or inactive user all resolve to the anonymous CurrentUser() default, never raise. 11 tests in tests/unit/test_jwt_authentication_provider.py. Not yet registered in configure_container() -- that's T55. QA Decision: Approved with comments -- process gate only (authorization-recording, missing phase log, undocumented direct-to-main work all closed; the code and tests were independently verified correct throughout). Merged: PR #9, commit baed936. See docs/ImplementationLog/Stage3/Phase2.md.

QA Decision: Approved with comments -- code/tests approved on the merits; four process/governance deviations named (authorization not recorded in-repository before implementation, Backend Developer approval-checkpoint skipped, implemented directly on main, consequently uncommitted). backendSubsystems.name: Stage 3 Phase 2 -- RequirePermission dependency factory (T54)
backendSubsystems.note: presentation/api/deps.py: RequirePermission(permission) -> a FastAPI dependency, plus a new get_authorization_service() resolver mirroring get_authentication_provider()'s shape. The returned dependency resolves CurrentUserDep and AuthorizationService (T53), then calls require_permission(user, permission) -- raises ForbiddenError on denial, handled by the project's existing exception handler. Closes Stage 2.5's flagged-not-scheduled finding F11. 5 tests in tests/unit/test_auth.py's TestRequirePermission class. Not yet called by any route -- no route exists yet (Phase 3, T58+). Unlike T53, the Backend Developer approval checkpoint WAS performed and approved for T54. See docs/ImplementationLog/Stage3/Phase2.md.

backendSubsystems.name: Stage 3 Phase 2 -- request-scoped AuthenticationProvider/AuthorizationService wiring (T55)
backendSubsystems.note: presentation/api/deps.py's get_authentication_provider()/get_authorization_service() now build JwtAuthenticationProvider/RbacAuthorizationService fresh per request, directly from DBSessionDep (via SqlAlchemyUserRepository/SqlAlchemyRolePermissionRepository), instead of resolving them from the DI container -- container.resolve() is synchronous/zero-argument and has no mechanism to inject a request-bound AsyncSession into a factory. infrastructure/di/container.py's two AuthenticationProvider/AuthorizationService registrations removed (confirmed unused elsewhere by direct inspection). RBAC permission mapping loaded fresh per request, no caching policy. 6 new integration tests in tests/integration/test_auth_dependency_wiring.py, including request-scoped-session-identity proofs on both sides.
